reviews.author: Charles Parrish
reviews.text: Reliable and quick pick up time when I need cars transported to the body shop for the insurance companies. Their scheduling is great as well as their follow up.

reviews.author: Joyce Vollmer
reviews.text: These folks are real life-savers! The nicest gentleman came to our rescue when we had a flat tire a few days ago. It was blazing hot outside in the middle of the day, but he cheerfully changed our tire for us and got us back on our way very quickly. He provided such kind and professional service! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Madison Schopp
reviews.text: After waiting 2 hours for AAA, decided to cancel our tow with them and call Parrish Towing. The kindest lady on the phone set someone to come tow us. Within 20 minutes of getting off the phone, John arrived to tow our truck from Kinston to Jacksonville. He was very communicative and even placed our keys in the dealership drop box with a form filled out detailing our info for the dealership to call us. Grateful for the quick and efficient service.

reviews.author: tapangahaddock
reviews.text: I broke down on the highway at 2 AM, completely stranded and stressed, but Parrish towing company came through like heroes. From the moment I called, they were professional, quick, and reassuring. The driver arrived faster than expected, treated me with genuine kindness, and made sure I felt safe the entire time. You could tell they really care about their customers, not just the job. I can’t thank them enough for turning a nightmare situation into a smooth, stress-free experience. Highly recommend to anyone in need of reliable, honest, and compassionate towing service, especially in the middle of the night!

reviews.author: Tony Hill
reviews.text: 5 stars to Parrish Towing. Battery died on my wife’s car on a Sunday morning. Called for help and he was able to purchase a new battery for me, come to the house and install it and got us back on the road. Excellent customer service and very nice and professional.

reviews.author: Tabitha Beach
reviews.text: If I could give them 10 stars, I would! We're located in Virginia and needed assistance with a repossession in their area. They went above and beyond to make everything smooth in receiving the car, in dealing with the customer, and communication with us! Blankenship Auto Inc definitely hit a homerun with these folks! We would absolutely use them again and again! Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Paul Such
reviews.text: After my truck got wrecked they showed up and made a stressful situation so much smoother. A huge thank you to the company and the kindness they show clients.

reviews.author: Sarah Kordulewski-Chavez
reviews.text: Within 24 hours notice they relocated an old car of my dad's that had been sitting for over 20 years. They did a great job and I would use them again. Thanks again for taking care of our family treasure!

reviews.author: Phong Nguyen
reviews.text: Very fast response with A+ service. Polite and respectful employee’s that will handle your vehicle with extra care. Would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Ample Improvements
reviews.text: They were incredible and professional. I highly recommend them. We had a completed situation that they resolved in no time. Thanks so much Parrish Towing and Hauling.

reviews.author: Aaron Jones
reviews.text: Excellent service provided by this company! My mother's car quit on her in town and these guys came right to her rescue. Towed it to her local mechanic shop and provided her a ride home. A+ rating in my book!

reviews.author: Christian Harner
reviews.text: Blew a tire late at night. They promptly arrived and towed me to a tire shop and to my hotel. I definitely recommend this company.

reviews.author: Gloria lucas
reviews.text: The most professional service with the nicest well mannered gentleman you will ever come across. Towed my car to Kinston Tire & Automotive. Had me back on the road in no time. Thank you Mr. Parrish!

reviews.author: A Young Adults Life
reviews.text: Rude and unprofessional. Post pics of ur vehicle on their fb page without permission and makes unprofessional and inhumane snarky remarks about clients who are traumatized for their amusement. DO NOT RECOMMEND!

reviews.author: Linda Durham
reviews.text: I need help with towing. Called this guy. He came out promptly and towed me to a shop in Kinston nc called kinston Automotive and tire. Great service from both!!! Can't recommend these companies enough!!!

reviews.author: Samantha Gibson
reviews.text: Called Parrish towing to haul my car to Kinston Automotive couldn't ask for better customer service and the best rates between the both businesses would recommend the two to anyone needing there services I would give them 10 stars.

reviews.author: alayna spence
reviews.text: Driver is nice he came out 30 mins after my call towed my vehicle from home and brought it to Kinston automotive for me which was a great help..

reviews.author: Nikki Taylor
reviews.text: I called at 8am when my daughters car broke down on side of the road and he was there quickly!! I can't say enough great things about them!

reviews.author: AmoLasTangas Gomez Hernandez
reviews.text: Very kind, excellent service, everything was professional. I highly recommend them to everyone, especially the Hispanic community. They arrived quickly to rescue me after my truck broke down on Highway 258 North, the exit to Kingston, NC, and brought me all the way to Snow Hill, NC. The tow truck driver is very kind, professional, and completely trustworthy. Sincerely, Dalia Gomez Hernandez
